topic: How has India's literacy rate changed since 1951?

claims.claim: The 1951 reported literacy rate was 18.33%, below one in five.
claims.passage: Table 6, ALL INDIA row and notes. The 1951 reported literacy rate was 18.33%, below one in five.

claims.claim: The 2001 reported literacy rate was 64.84%, nearly two in three.
claims.passage: Table 6, ALL INDIA row and notes. The 2001 reported literacy rate was 64.84%, nearly two in three.

claims.claim: The table's 2011 reported rate was 72.99%, nearly three in four. The series uses ages five and up through 1971 and seven and up thereafter.
